nodes.author: nilyaaj
nodes.text: I had bronchitis in November and my sister (NP in a hospital setting) said it might be from RSV or HMPV. Urgent care near me doesn’t even test for these things. Would’ve had to find a pulmonologist… why is community healthcare in this country so… archaic.

nodes.author: nilyaaj
nodes.text: HMPV been out since 2001 and doctors offices and urgent care can’t test? No at home test yet? The media wasn’t going to say anything about it for the 24th year until China’s CDC brought it up.

nodes.author: nilyaaj
nodes.text: I guess if you had bronchitis or pneumonia, and tested negative for cold, flu a+b , and strep you could’ve had HMPV. Keep masking. We can’t afford deference or selective behavior.
